---
title: "Posts"
listing:
  id: posts
  type: metadata
  contents: posts/*.qmd
  sort: "date desc"
components:
  - name: filter-table
    src: filter-table.js
---

The listing resolves the posts and publishes them at `meta.listings.posts`;
the cell below hands them to a component as props, with a plain list as
the no-script version.

```{lmd}
local items = meta.listings.posts.items
local rows = items:map(function(it)
  return {
    title = pandoc.utils.stringify(it.title),
    href = it["output-href"],
    date = it.date,
    categories = it.categories,
  }
end)
local list = pandoc.BulletList(items:map(function(it)
  return {=: `{lmd} pandoc.Link(it.title, it.path)` (`{lmd} it.date`) :=}
end))
return quarto.component("filter-table", { rows = rows }, { list })
```
